Had to turn my viral baked lasagne jacket into a tray bake for four … because one potato simply isn’t enough when comfort food calls 🥔😂 This is a take on my baked lasagne style jacket potato just bigger, better, and perfect for feeding four instead of one. Fluffy crispy jackets. Rich leftover Bolognese. Creamy cheesy béchamel. Finished with a golden cheese melt. Would you share this… or keep the whole tray to yourself? 👀 🥔 Lasagne-Style Jacket Potato Tray Bake Serves 4 Ingredients Jackets • 4 large baking potatoes • Olive oil spray • Sea salt & black pepper • 40g butter Filling • 600–700g leftover Bolognese sauce Cheesy Béchamel Sauce • 40g butter • 40g plain flour • 500ml semi-skimmed milk • Black pepper • 100g mixed grated cheese • 30–40g grated Parmesan For layering • 150–200g mozzarella or mixed cheese • Extra Parmesan for topping Method 1. Cook the jacket potatoes Pierce potatoes, rub with olive oil and salt. Air fry at 180°C for 45 minutes, then another 10 minutes until crispy. Oven option: 200°C for about 1 hour until fluffy inside and crunchy outside. 2. Make the cheesy béchamel Melt butter in a pan over medium heat. Stir in flour and cook for 1 minute. Gradually whisk in the milk until smooth and thickened. Season with black pepper, then stir through mixed cheese and Parmesan until melted and creamy. Set aside. 3. Assemble the tray bake Place all 4 crispy jackets into a large tray. Slice open and gently mash the centres with butter, salt and pepper. 👉 Spoon 1 tablespoon of béchamel into each potato and mix through the fluffy middle. Now layer in this order: • Add the leftover Bolognese • Pour over more béchamel sauce • Sprinkle over mozzarella or mixed cheese • Finish with a generous grating of Parmesan 4. Final melt Bake at 180°C for 10–12 minutes or air fry at 180°C for 4–5 minutes until golden, bubbling and irresistible. #foryoupagе #spud #jacketpotato #jacketpotatoes #lasagna

This is seriously one of the best appetizers I’ve ever made, and easy to throw together! 🤤 roasted tomato burrata dip with garlic bread crostinis!) 🍅🧄 Ripe bursted cherry tomatoes, stir in burrata, and scoop it all up with crispy garlic crostinis. A total flavor bomb… have the recipe ready, people WILL ask for it! 🛒You’ll Need: • cherry tomatoes • Olive oil • Salt, pepper, red pepper flakes • Garlic, parsley, oregano • Burrata • Fresh basil • Parmesan • French baguette • Butter, garlic, salt, parm (for garlic butter) 🧈 How to Make: 	1.	Add grape tomatoes to a baking dish and drizzle generously with olive oil (about halfway up). 	2.	Season with salt, pepper, red pepper flakes, garlic, parsley, and oregano. 	3.	Bake at 425°F for 20-30 mins until tomatoes burst (you can gently smash them halfway if they need some assistance in the ‘bursting’ process). 	4.	While that bakes, slice baguette, spread with garlic butter (butter, garlic, salt, parm), and toast 5–7 mins until golden. 	5.	Once you’re ready to serve, top with parm, fresh basil, and burrata. Stir it all together and serve HOT. Dip. Scoop. Repeat. I decided to double up on reel meals since I’m behind with editing… Loaded Chicken Twice Baked Potato!!! Nuff said. I wish y’all could taste through the screen omg. I tore this meal DOWN ——————————————— RECIPEEEE! If y'all been following me y'all know I do not measure but i'll try my best.  Ingredients:  - Russet Potatoes  - Heavy Cream - Colby Jack Cheese - Seasonings for taste (in step list)  - Sharp Cheddar Cheese  - Unsalted Butter  - Vegetable Oil - Broccoli (optional for filling) - Aluminum Foil - Garlic Paste  - Sour Cream - EVOO - Cubed Chicken (cut up breasts or tenderloin)  [Baked Potato] * 1st you want to prep your potatoes. You're basically making a baked potato. Take your potatoes (russet) and wash them. Then cover with oil (I used vegetable oil) and individually wrap each potato tightly in aluminum foil. Bake in the oven at 400 degrees F for about an hour. * Once potatoes are soft and cooked completely remove the foil and cut down the middle of each potato, hot dog style. Scoop out the inside of the potato and put into an empty mixing bowl. To the mixing bowl you're going to add 1 stick of unsalted melted butter, tbsp of garlic paste, parsley, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp garlic salt, cooked broccoli, 1/2c grated sharp cheddar cheese, pepper, and 2 tbsp sour cream. Mix together and scoop filling back into potatoes. [Sauce]  * Add 1 tbsp butter to pan, 1 tsp garlic paste and parsley and melt down. Add about 1cup of heavy cream and let cook for 5 minutes to thicken. Add pepper, onion powder and lawrys seasoning salt to season. Add colby jack cheese (about 1cup) and mix until sauce is thick and consistency you like. [Chicken]  * I used chicken beasts and cut into cubes. Add EVOO and seasoned with parsley, onion powder, garlic powder and adobo. Cooked in a greased pan until done. * Add thin layer of sauce on potatoes, then chicken, then sauce again and finally top with more cheese and bake on 125 until cheese is melted. #loadedpotato #twicebakedpotato #chickenloadedpotato #cookingtiktok #chefd #fivestarmeals #dinnerideas #dinnerinspo

Garlic Parmesan chicken pasta ✨ Ingredients  Chicken  - 1.5 lbs chicken breast, cut in half - 1 tsp roasted garlic powder  - 1 tsp smoked paprika  - 1 tsp oregano  - 1 tsp Italian seasoning  - 1 tsp garlic and herb seasoning  - Salt to taste - 1 tbsp avocado oil (for cooking) - 1 tbsp unsalted butter (for cooking) Sauce + pasta - 14 oz fettuccine pasta  - 1 1/2 cup heavy cream - 6 tbsp unsalted butter - 1/4 cup pasta water - 7 garlic cloves (minced) - 1 shallot (minced) - 1 1/4 cups Parmesan cheese (grated)  - 1 tbsp freshly chopped parsley  - 1 1/2 tsp oregano  - 1 1/2 tsp roasted garlic powder - 1 tsp red chili flakes - Salt and pepper to taste  Instructions  - In a large bowl coat chicken breast with about 2 tsp of olive oil, seasonings, salt and mix until evenly coated. Cover and set aside for 30 minutes to marinate. - Heat a skillet over medium-high heat. Add avocado oil and 1 tbsp of butter. - Sear chicken for 5 minutes per side until a golden crust forms. Deglaze pan with a little chicken broth, lower the heat, cover, and simmer until internal temperature reaches 155F. - Remove chicken from pan, cover in foil, and place into oven set warm. Pasta  - Bring a large pot of water to a rolling boil. Salt it heavily. - Cook pasta according to package instructions until al dente. - Reserve at least 1/4 cup pasta water, then drain. Sauce - To the same pan (medium heat) add butter. - Sauté shallot for 1–2 minutes until soft. - Add minced garlic and cook until fragrant (about 30 seconds). - Season with oregano, garlic powder, chili flakes, salt, and black pepper. Mix until well combined and fragrant  -  Pour in heavy cream and mix  - Simmer gently for 3–5 minutes until slightly thickened. - Lower heat and stir in Parmesan  cheese and pasta water. Mix until well combined. Taste and adjust for seasonings. - Add cooked fettuccine and parsley, mixing until well coated. - Stir in an additional ¼ cup Parmesan until fully combined. - Finish with chopped parsley. - Add sliced chicken on top of pasta  - Finish with extra Parmesan, cracked pepper, or chili flakes if desired. • • • #recipes #pasta #dinnerideas #chickenrecipe #foodideas

This One Pan Chicken & Gravy is an easy and delicious 30 minute dinner!  INGREDIENTS  1 lb chicken breasts  Salt, pepper, garlic powder  3 tbsp butter 3 tbsp flour  2 cups chicken broth  1/2 tsp each of salt, pepper, oregano, and thyme  1 tsp each of paprika, onion powder, garlic powder  INSTRUCTIONS  Cut chicken breasts in half lengthwise to make them thinner. Season the chicken with some salt, pepper, and garlic powder (I don’t use exact measurements for this part).  In a skillet over medium high heat melt 3 tbsp of butter. Once the butter has melted add 3 tbsp of flour and stir continuously until well combined. Let cook for a few minutes while still stirring.  Add 2 cups of chicken broth and stir well. Season with salt, pepper, oregano, thyme, paprika, onion powder, and garlic powder. Stir well and when it starts bubbling add the chicken to the skillet.  Make sure the chicken is covered in the gravy, cover with a lid, and turn the heat down to medium low. Let this cook for 12-15 minutes or until the chicken reaches an internal temp of 165 degrees. My chicken was ready in 12 minutes, but they were pretty thin.  Shred the chicken and serve over mashed potatoes! Enjoy! Let me know if you give it a go 😄 Chris x CREAM CHEESE CHICKEN | Serves 4 INGREDIENTS ➡️CHICKEN: 2x 250g/9oz Chicken Breasts, brought close to room temp 1/2 tsp EACH: Smoked Paprika, Salt 1/4 tsp EACH: Garlic Powder, Onion Powder, Dried Oregano, Black Pepper, plus more to serve 1/8 tsp Dried Thyme 1 tbsp EACH: Unsalted Butter, Olive Oil ➡️SAUCE: 2 Shallots, very finely diced 180ml / 3/4 cup Chicken Stock (use low-salt if sensitive to salt) 1x 165g/5.8oz tub of full-fat Cream Cheese, brought close to room temp (I use Philadelphia) 1 tsp Dijon Mustard finely diced Fresh Chives, to serve METHOD 1️⃣Horizontally slice each chicken breast right through the centre to create 4 even-sized breasts. Combine the seasoning mix in a small pot or bowl, then evenly sprinkle over both sides of each breast. 2️⃣Place a large pan over medium-high heat and stir in the butter and oil. Add the chicken and fry for a few minutes on each side, or until lightly charred on the outside and piping hot/white through the centre. Remove and place on a plate to one side then lower the heat to medium. 3️⃣Add the shallots and fry in the leftover fat until soft and golden. Pour in the stock, then stir in the cream cheese until it blends into a sauce. You'll need to give it a good whisk to smooth out all the small lumps. Stir in the dijon, then stir in the resting juices from the chicken. 4️⃣The sauce should be relatively thick already, but if it's not just gently simmer for a couple of minutes. If you over thicken it just stir in a splash more stock or water to thin it out. 5️⃣Add the chicken back in and baste in the sauce, then sprinkle with chives and a pinch of black pepper. Serve up and enjoy!

If there is one meal that belongs on your fall dinner table, it’s a cozy pot roast. Slow cooked until tender, served over creamy mashed potatoes and finished with a rich broth. It’s the ultimate comfort meal for fall 🍂 Full recipe down below, you can also find it in the link in my bio 🤎  Beef pot roast Ingredients: 	⁃	2-3 lb chuck roast 	⁃	1 medium white onion, sliced 	⁃	3 celery stalks, diced 	⁃	3 large carrots, sliced  	⁃	Bite size potatoes 	⁃	5 garlic cloves, minced 	⁃	Rosemary  	⁃	Thyme 	⁃	2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce 	⁃	3 tbsp tomato paste 	⁃	2 Au jus gravy packets 	⁃	6 cups beef bone broth 	⁃	3 tbsp unsalted butter 	⁃	2 tbsp onion powder 	⁃	2 tbsp garlic powder 	⁃	Salt to taste Instructions: Wash and prep all of your vegetables. Peel and dice the carrots, slice the onion, mince the garlic, and dice the celery. Season the chuck roast to your liking. I used onion powder, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Make sure to season all sides of the roast. Add oil to a Dutch oven and sear the roast on all sides for 3–4 minutes per side. Remove the roast from the pot and set aside. Add the celery and onion to the pot and cook over medium heat until the onion has caramelized. Add the minced garlic last to prevent it from burning. Add the tomato paste, Worcestershire sauce, and gravy packets. Add ½ cup of beef broth to deglaze the pot, then pour in the remaining broth. Add the seasonings and taste to make sure everything is seasoned to your liking. Add the roast back to the pot, along with the carrots, potatoes, butter, and a bunch of rosemary and thyme tied together with butcher’s twine. Cover and place in a 350°F oven for 3 hours. About 30 minutes before the roast is finished, prepare the mashed potatoes. To assemble, add a bed of mashed potatoes to a plate, then top with the roast, potatoes, and carrots. Finish with some of the broth and fresh or dried parsley. Enjoy! 🤎 #fall #fallrecipes #potroast #cozyvibes #fallvibes

Dice your cucumbers into thin circles. 2. Lay your chicken thighs flat, season with salt and pepper, and coat evenly with cornstarch on both sides 3. On a pan coated with spray oil on medium heat, cook your chicken until golden brown, crispy on both sides, and cooked through. 5. In a bowl, mix together your sliced cucumbers with salt. Let it sit for 15 minutes until the excess liquid drains from the cucumbers. 7. Remove the excess liquid from the cucumbers and rinse the cucumbers with water. 8. Pat dry the cucumbers and add them into a bowl with rice vinegar, brown sugar, soy sauce, and sesame seeds and mix well to make your salad. 9. In a meal prep container, add 1/2 your steamed rice, 1/2 your cucumber salad, and 1/2 your chicken optionally topped with sesame seeds and sliced green onions. 10. Pro tip: when meal prepping to re-heat, make sure to put your salad & meat into separate ziploc bags to avoid getting the rice soggy. Creamy Tuscan Chicken 🍗✨ This creamy Tuscan chicken is packed with juicy seasoned chicken, garlic, spinach, and sweet grape tomatoes in a rich Parmesan cream sauce. It’s perfect served over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice! 😋  🍗 Creamy Tuscan Chicken Ingredients:  Chicken seasoning  * 2 to 3 chicken breasts, sliced in half * Salt & pepper * ½ tsp smoked paprika * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tbsp Italian seasoning * 1 tsp dried parsley * ½ tsp chili flakes (optional) Sauce: * 1 tbsp butter * ½ onion, diced * 3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 cup grape tomatoes, halved * 2 cups spinach * 1 cup heavy cream * ¼ cup grated Parmesan * Salt & pepper, to taste * Fresh parsley Directions: Season the chicken with all the spices. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a skillet and cook the chicken for 4–5 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Remove and set aside. In the same skillet, melt the butter and sauté the onion and garlic until fragrant. Add the tomatoes and cook for 2–3 minutes, then stir in the spinach until wilted. Pour in the heavy cream and Parmesan, stirring until smooth and creamy. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Return the chicken to the skillet and let simmer for 2–3 minutes. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice. Enjoy! 🤍

Creamy Pesto Chicken Pasta Bake ✨ My most viral recipe of 2024!  What a year it’s been. I’m truly so grateful for all the love and support you’ve shown me this year. Cheers to a delicious 2025!  Here’s how to make it: 1lb pasta of choice 1/2 cup sun-dried tomatoes + oil 1lb chicken 1 tbsp butter 1/2 yellow onion, diced Salt and pepper, to taste 1 tsp red pepper flakes (to taste) 1 tsp smoked paprika (to taste) 1 tsp oregano (to taste) 6-8 cloves of garlic, minced (to taste) 2 cups heavy cream (room temp) 1-2 cups cooked broccoli  2 handfuls spinach 6-8 oz freshly shredded parmesan cheese (divided) 8 oz freshly shredded mozzarella (divided) 1/2 cup pesto, to taste (I recommend Costco brand) Parsley to garnish  1. Preheat oven to 350°F. Place the cream on the counter to come to room temp. 2. Boil your noodles in salted water a few minutes less than package instructions (al dente). Drain and set aside.  3. In a large oven-safe saucepan or dutch oven, heat 1 tbsp of sun-dried tomato oil over medium heat. Cook the chicken until it's no longer pink, then remove it from the pan and set it aside. Let it rest for a few minutes before cutting into bite-sized pieces. 4. In the same pan, melt the butter and add salt, pepper, red pepper, paprika, and oregano. Stir to toast, then toss in the onion and sauté for about 4 minutes. Add the garlic and cook for another 30 seconds. 5. Turn heat to low, pour in the heavy cream and stir. Let it simmer for a couple of minutes to thicken slightly. 6. Add half of the parmesan and 1 cup of mozzarella cheese,  stir until the cheese is melted. 7. Stir in the sun-dried tomatoes, cooked broccoli, spinach, chicken, cooked pasta, and pesto. 8. Top with the remaining mozzarella and parmesan cheese.  9. Bake at 350°F for 15 minutes, then broil for another 5 minutes, or until the top is golden and bubbly. 10. Sprinkle with fresh parsley, a little more parmesan, and enjoy! #pastabake #chickenpesto #pesto #pestopasta #pestochicken #pasta #pastarecipe #easyrecipe #easyrecipes #easymeal #easydinner #dinnerideas #dinner #foodtok #cooking

Throwback to this Honey Garlic Lemon Pepper Chicken Thighs recipe. The full recipe is posted below and can also be found in my cookbook Let’s Get Into It! Check out my cookbook through the link in my bio. Notes: If you are doubling the recipe, do not add more lemon slices to the sauce as it will become too bitter. Ingredients: •4 bone-in Chicken Thighs •2 tsp Lemon Pepper Seasoning •2 tsp Garlic Powder •2 tsp Smoked Paprika •1 tsp Kosher Salt •1 tsp Black Pepper •1 tsp Onion Powder •3 tbsp Olive Oil Sauce •2 tbsp Unsalted Butter •¼ cup Honey •4 slices of Lemon •4 tsp minced garlic •1 tbsp freshly squeezed Lemon Juice •2 tsp Low-Sodium Soy Sauce Instructions: Prepare the Chicken 1. Clean and pat the thighs dry. In a small bowl, combine the lemon pepper seasoning, garlic powder, paprika, salt, black pepper, and onion powder. Stir in the olive oil to make a seasoning paste. Fully coat the thighs with the paste, spreading it underneath the thigh skin to flavor the meat. Transfer the chicken to a zip-top bag or a container with a lid. Let the thighs marinate for at least 2 hours or up to overnight. 2. When the chicken is done marinating, preheat the oven to 425°F (215°C). Line a large baking pan or 9x13-inch (23x33cm) baking pan with foil, set a baking rack in the pan, and coat the baking rack with nonstick cooking spray. 3. Place the thighs on the rack skin side down. Bake, uncovered. for 30 minutes. Turn over the thighs and continue to bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until cooked through. The internal temperature should be at least 165°F (75°C). When cutting into the chicken near the thickest section, all of the juices should run clear. While the chicken is baking we can prepare the sauce. Prepare the Sauce 4. In a large skillet over medium-low heat, melt the butter. When the butter is melted, add the honey, lemon slices, garlic, lemon juice, soy sauce, and 1 tablespoon water. Bring the sauce to a simmer, then cook, periodically stirring the sauce until it thickens, about 5 minutes. 5. When the chicken is done, brush the sauce all over both sides and bake for an additional 5 minutes, until the sauce has browned and turned sticky. Allow the thighs to cool for 3 to 5 minutes, then enjoy! #royaleeats

Macros Per Serving (4 Servings Total) 569 Calories | 57g Protein | 46g Carbs | 17g Fat Ingredients (To Make 4 Servings) Garlic Parmesan Crusted Chicken - 800g Chicken Breasts cut into thin fillets - 2 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Italian Herbs - 2 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Paprika - 3 Tsp Olive Oil - 40g Parmesan Mix till well coated on both sides, add more seasoning if needed Creamy Mash Potatoes - 900g Raw Potatoes cut into 1 inch cubes - 15g Light Butter - 100ml Light Evaporated Milk (Brand: Sainsbury’s) - 1 Tsp Garlic Powder - 1 Tsp Salt - 1 Tsp Black Pepper Mix till smooth & fluffy, add more seasoning to taste preference Creamy Sauce - 1/2 Tsp each Garlic Powder, Italian Herbs, Salt, Paprika - 250ml Milk - 150g Light Cream Cheese (Brand: Philadelphia Lightest) - 20g Parmesan Don’t forget to check out my Digital Cookbooks with over 200+ recipes just like this!👨‍🍳❤️ Important Cooking Notes - When coating the chicken, make sure both sides are covered equally. Chris x CHICKEN FRANCESE | Serves 4 INGREDIENTS ➡️CHICKEN 2x 250g/9oz Chicken Breasts, close to room temp 35g / 1/4 cup Plain Flour 3/4 tsp Salt 1/2 tsp EACH: Black Pepper, Garlic Powder 2 Eggs 20g / 1/4 cup Parmesan (I use the refrigerated dusty stuff) 1 1/2 tbsp Olive Oil 1 tbsp/15g Unsalted Butter ➡️SAUCE 1 large Lemon, slice 4 thin rings from the centre then squeeze 1 tbsp juice from the ends 60ml / 1/4 cup Dry White Wine 180ml / 3/4 cup Chicken Stock 4 tbsp/60g Unsalted Butter, diced into small cubes (keep in the fridge until needed) 2 tbsp finely diced Fresh Chives METHOD 1️⃣Take two large shallow dishes. In the 1st combine the flour & seasoning and in the 2nd beat the egg & whisk in the parmesan. Lay two chicken breasts on a chopping board and horizontally slice them right through the centre to create 4 even-sized breasts. Individually coat each of them in the flour then return to the chopping board. 2️⃣Add 1 1/2 tbsp oil & 1 tbsp butter to a large non-stick pan over medium-high heat. Place the bowl with the egg next to the pan, then one by one coat the chicken in the egg, allow excess to drip off, then place in the pan. Cook each side for around 3mins, or until golden on the outside and just about cooked right through the centre. Remove the chicken from the pan and place on a plate to one side. Add the lemon slices to the pan and fry for around 20 secs each side, just until they start to soften & lightly colour. Remove from the pan (don't rest on the chicken). 3️⃣Pour in the wine and rapid simmer for around 2mins, or until it has mostly evaporated, deglazing the pan as needed. Pour in the stock and 1 tbsp lemon juice (you can adjust this later) and bring to a simmer. 4️⃣Add the cubed butter to the leftover flour then toss coat. Add the floured butter to the pan and swiftly whisk until it blends into the stock. Add the chives and continue simmering and stirring until the sauce turns cloudy and thickens slightly to a glossy texture. Generously season to taste. 5️⃣Add the chicken alongside any resting juices and place then lemon slices on top. Baste in the sauce to warm it back through then serve and enjoy.

Honey Garlic Chicken! 🍯 🧄  Sticky, sweet, garlicky, and comes together so easy… this one’s a weeknight winner every time!! @Courtney Cook made my recipe the other day and it made me want it all over again!! Serve it over rice with a veggie, so good y’all.  Ingredients:  • 3 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite-size pieces  • ½ tbsp garlic salt  • 1 tbsp black pepper  • ¼ cup cornstarch (plus a little extra if you want more crunch)  • 2–3 tbsp vegetable oil (for frying) Sauce:  • ½ cup honey  • ¼ cup soy sauce  • 1 tbsp ginger paste  • 2–3 tbsp minced garlic To Finish:  • Sesame seeds  • Green onions, sliced ⸻ Instructions:  1. Season the chicken In a large bowl, add chicken, garlic salt, black pepper, and cornstarch. Toss until everything is well coated. (Add a little extra cornstarch if you want it extra crispy.)  2. Cook the chicken Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add chicken in batches and cook until browned on both sides with a light crust. Don’t overcrowd the pan. Remove and set aside.  3. Make the sauce Add all the cooked chicken back to the skillet. Pour in honey, soy sauce, ginger paste, and minced garlic. Toss to coat.  4. Simmer Let it simmer for a few minutes until the sauce thickens and gets sticky, coating all the chicken.  5. Finish & serve Top with sesame seeds and green onions. Serve over white rice with your favorite veggie.  #yum #easyrecipe #chicken

Recipe Name Deep Dish Pepperoni Cheeseburger Pizza Pie Ingredients 1. 1 lb pizza dough 2. 1 lb ground beef 3. 1 cup pepperoni slices 4. 1 small onion, diced 5. 1/2 green bell pepper, diced 6. 3 garlic cloves, minced 7. 2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese 8. 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese 9. 1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese 10. 1 cup pizza sauce 11. 1 tsp Italian seasoning 12. 1/2 tsp oregano 13. 1/2 tsp garlic powder 14. 1/2 tsp onion powder 15. 1/2 tsp salt 16. 1/2 tsp black pepper 17. 1 tbsp olive oil Recipe 1. Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C) and grease a deep cake pan or springform pan. 2. Press the pizza dough into the pan, covering the bottom and sides. 3. Heat olive oil in a skillet and cook the onion, bell pepper, and garlic until softened. 4. Add the ground beef and cook until browned. Drain excess grease. 5. Stir in pizza sauce, Italian seasoning, oregano, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and black pepper. 6. Spread half of the mozzarella over the crust. 7. Spoon the beef mixture evenly over the cheese. 8. Sprinkle the cheddar and Parmesan over the beef. 9. Arrange pepperoni slices on top and finish with the remaining mozzarella. 10. Bake for 35–40 minutes until the crust is golden and the cheese is bubbly. 11. Let the pie rest for 10 minutes before slicing. 12. Serve hot with extra pizza sauce if desired. The high-protein, low-carb dinner I wish I knew about sooner… and best part, it only takes 15 minutes!! #RECIPE Enoki Beef Rolls 🍄 Ingredients (3-4 servings): 1 lb thinly sliced beef (I used “shabu shabu beef”) 7 oz enoki mushrooms 1 white onion, thinly sliced 1 tbsp oil (avocado oil preferred) 2 eggs, whisked Garnish: chopped green onions, sesame seeds Sauce: 1/3 cup water 1/4 cup soy sauce 1 tbsp sesame oil 1 garlic clove, minced Dash of pepper 🥩 Instructions: Prep the mushrooms – Trim the bottom 1-2 inches off the enoki mushrooms, rinse, and separate into small bundles. Roll it up – Lay out a slice of beef and roll each enoki bundle tightly inside. Repeat until all are wrapped. Make the sauce – Mix all sauce ingredients in a bowl and set aside. Sauté the onions – Heat oil in a large skillet over med-high heat, add onions, and cook for 3min until softened. Cook the rolls – Place the beef rolls over the onions in a single layer, pour in the sauce, cover, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low-med and simmer for 3min (until beef is cooked through). Add the eggs – Uncover, pour whisked eggs over the rolls, cover again, and cook for 1min.  Finish & serve – Salt to taste. Remove from heat, garnish with green onions and sesame seeds. Enjoy! #creatorsearchinsights

Start by seasoning your chicken breast with chipotle seasoning, olive oil & mix. 2. Using a stove with the pan on medium heat cook the chicken with a lid for approximately 8 - 10 minutes per side or until fully cooked through, once cooked shred the chicken apart using 2 forks. 3. In a blender cup add low fat cottage cheese, chipotle seasoning, light mayonnaise, garlic, lime juice, chipotle in adobo sauce, buffalo sauce, honey & blend for 2 minutes until smooth & creamy. 4. In a large bowl combined the blended chipotle sauce, shredded chicken, chives & grated cheese until well combined. 5. Place a warm tortilla down & to one half add a layer of cheese followed by 1/10th of the filling, another layer of cheese & fold. 6. Toast on a pan on each side until golden brown & crispy, repeat for the other 9 quesadillas.  #quesadilla #chicken #highprotein #healthyrecipes #mealprep

Complete dinner in under 30 minutes✨ One pot, simple ingredients, minimal cleanup, and a dinner everyone actually gets excited about. Juicy chicken thighs, cozy penne pasta, and the freshest, creamiest side salad. These are the kinds of meals that end up on repeat in my kitchen because they’re easy, comforting, and just so good🥰 Ingredients 🐓🍝🥗 One pot chicken & pasta 1½ pounds boneless skinless chicken thighs/breast 1 onion, sliced ¼ cup olive oil 1 teaspoon salt 1 teaspoon paprika 1 teaspoon garlic powder ½ teaspoon black pepper 1 package 16 oz penne pasta  4 cups chicken broth or any broth you love ½ cup tomato paste Side salad 🥒🍅🥑 4 Persian cucumbers, chopped About a cup of cherry tomatoes  1 shallot  1 avocado  Olive oil Fresh lemon juice  Fresh lime juice  Salt and pepper Instructions Place the chicken thighs in a bowl. Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt, paprika, garlic powder, and black pepper. Mix until evenly coated. Heat a large pot over medium heat. Add the chicken and sear for a few minutes on each side until golden. Scatter the sliced onion right over the chicken and let it soften in all the flavor. In a separate bowl or measuring cup, whisk together the broth and tomato paste until smooth. Once the chicken is nicely browned, add the pasta directly into the pot. Pour the tomato broth mixture right over the chicken and pasta and bring everything to a boil. Cover, reduce to a simmer, and cook for about 10 minutes until the pasta is tender and the chicken is fully cooked through. While everything cooks, chop the cucumbers cucumbers, cherry tomatoes, shallot, and avocado. Drizzle with olive oil and fresh lemon and lime juice, season with salt and pepper, and toss. That’s it. Quick and easy cinnamon roll bites 😮‍💨😋 Ingredients: Pillsbury Grands biscuits  ⅓ cup unsalted butter, melted ⅓ cup granulated sugar ½ tablespoon ground cinnamon 1½ cups powdered sugar ⅓ cup heavy whipping cream ½ tablespoon vanilla bean paste or extract Instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F. Using a 16.3-ounce can of Pillsbury Grands biscuits, cut each biscuit into quarters and gently roll each piece into a ball. Transfer the biscuit pieces to a mixing bowl. Add the melted butter and cinnamon sugar, then gently toss until each piece is evenly coated. Lightly spray a 9x9-inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray or coat it with a thin layer of butter. Transfer the coated biscuit pieces to the baking dish and spread them out evenly. Bake at 350°F for 25–28 minutes, or until golden brown and cooked through. While the cinnamon roll bites are baking, prepare the icing. In a bowl, whisk together 1½ cups of powdered sugar, ⅓ cup of heavy whipping cream, and about ½ tablespoon of vanilla bean paste or vanilla extract. For a thicker icing, add more powdered sugar. For a thinner consistency, add a little more heavy whipping cream. Let the cinnamon roll bites cool for about 5 minutes before drizzling or spreading the icing over the top. One-Pot Chicken Fajita Rice Skillet Recipe  Ingredients: 1 tablespoon olive oil 1 onion, sliced 3 bell peppers, sliced into strips yellow, red & green 2 chicken breasts, sliced into strips 1 packet fajita seasoning 1 tablespoon garlic 1 can Rotel, undrained 1 cup rice, washed  1 teaspoon tomato bouillon 2 cups chicken broth Queso: 1 can green chiles 1 small can evaporated milk (5 oz) ½ pound white American cheese slices, from the deli Directions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the sliced onion and bell peppers and cook until softened. Add the sliced chicken and fajita seasoning. Stir to coat everything and cook until the chicken is fully cooked through. Add the garlic and Rotel. Stir to combine. Add the rice, chicken broth, and tomato bouillon. Stir everything together. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low. Cover and cook for 20 minutes, or until the rice is tender and the liquid has been absorbed. While the rice cooks, make the queso. Add the evaporated milk, green chiles, and the white American cheese to a small saucepan over low heat. Stir until the cheese is completely melted and the queso is smooth. Fluff the rice, then pour the queso evenly over the top. Serve hot. #OnePotMeals #DinnerIdeas #EasyRecipe #WeeknightDinner #MealIdeas

Strawberry Pull-Apart Bread 🍓✨ Dough: 3 cups all-purpose flour (360g) 5 tbsp melted butter (71g) 3 tbsp granulated sugar (38g) 1 tsp salt (6g) 2¼ tsp active dry yeast (7g) 1 large egg (50g) ¾ cup warm milk (180g) 1 tsp vanilla extract Simple Glaze: 1 cup powdered sugar (120g) 1–2 tbsp milk (15–30g) 1 tbsp melted butter (14g) Splash of vanilla extract Strawberry Compote Ingredients:  300g strawberries (about 2 cups, chopped) 75–90g granulated sugar (6–7 tbsp) 1 tbsp lemon juice 10–12g cornstarch (1–1½ tbsp) 30g water (2 tbsp) Instructions: In a bowl, mix warm milk, sugar, and yeast and let sit for 8–10 minutes until foamy, then add the egg, melted butter, and vanilla and mix until combined; add in the flour and salt and knead for about 8–10 minutes until smooth, then cover and let rise for 1 hour or until doubled. Meanwhile, make the strawberry compote by cooking strawberries, sugar, and lemon juice over medium heat until soft and juicy (about 5–7 minutes), lightly mash, then stir in the cornstarch mixed with water and cook until thickened, then let cool completely. Roll the dough into a rectangle, spread the strawberry compote evenly over the surface, cut into strips, stack them, and slice into pieces, then place upright into a greased loaf pan, cover and let rise for another 30 minutes before baking at 350°F (175°C) for 35–45 minutes until golden, then mix the glaze ingredients and drizzle over the warm bread. #breadmaking #strawberry #pullapartbread #baking #recipes

Recipe Name: Slow Cooker Creamy Garlic Parmesan Pork Chops Ingredients 1. 4 bone-in pork chops 2. 1 tsp salt 3. 1/2 tsp black pepper 4. 1 tsp garlic powder 5. 1 tsp onion powder 6. 1 tbsp olive oil 7. 3 tbsp butter 8. 4 cloves garlic, minced 9. 1 cup chicken broth 10. 1 cup heavy cream 11. 1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese 12. 1 tsp Italian seasoning 13. 1/2 tsp paprika 14. 1 tbsp cornstarch 15. 2 tbsp water 16. 2 tbsp chopped parsley Recipe 1. Pat the pork chops dry with paper towels. 2. Season both sides with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, and paprika. 3. Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. 4. Sear the pork chops for 2–3 minutes per side until golden brown. 5. Transfer the pork chops to a slow cooker. 6. In the same skillet, melt butter and sauté the garlic for 30 seconds. 7. Pour in the chicken broth and scrape up any browned bits from the pan. 8. Stir in the heavy cream, Parmesan cheese, and Italian seasoning. 9. Pour the creamy mixture over the pork chops in the slow cooker. 10. Cover and cook on LOW for 5–6 hours or HIGH for 2½–3 hours. 11. Mix cornstarch and water in a small bowl until smooth. 12. Stir the slurry into the slow cooker during the last 20 minutes of cooking. 13. Let the sauce thicken while the pork chops finish cooking. 14. Spoon the creamy garlic Parmesan sauce over the pork chops. 15. Garnish with fresh parsley before serving. 16. Serve hot with mashed potatoes, rice, or roasted vegetables. Recipes makes 6 servings: 1 serving is 477 calories, 57g protein 18 fat 16 carb Cheesy Buffalo Bacon Chicken and Potatoes Ingredients: * 3 medium russet potatoes * 32 oz. cubed raw skinless chicken * 1 cup Frank’s Red Hot Buffalo Sauce * 120g reduced fat cheddar cheese * 120g reduced fat mozzarella cheese * 14 slices center cut bacon * 60g 1/3 reduced fat cream cheese * Salt, pepper, onion powder, garlic powder, paprika Instructions: 1. Prepare the Potatoes:  * Wash and dice the russet potatoes into bite-sized pieces. Toss with olive oil, salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, and paprika. 2. Air Fry the Potatoes:  * Preheat the air fryer to 400°F (200°C). Place the seasoned potatoes in the air fryer basket and cook for 15-20 minutes, shaking halfway through, until golden and crispy. 3. Cook the Bacon:  * In a large skillet, cook the bacon over medium heat until crispy. Remove and drain on paper towels, then chop into small pieces. 4. Cook the Chicken:  * In the same skillet, remove excess bacon fat, leaving about 1 tablespoon. Add the cubed chicken and season with salt, pepper, onion powder, garlic powder, and paprika. Cook until the chicken is browned and cooked through, about 7-10 minutes. (165 or higher internal temp) 5. Add Buffalo Sauce:  * Stir in the Frank’s Red Hot Buffalo Sauce and cream cheese into the cooked chicken. Mix until the cream cheese is fully combined and the sauce is thick. 6. in a large bowl combine your creamy buffalo chicken with your chopped bacon, 140g reduced fat cheese and stir in as it melts.  7. Evenly distribute your cooked potato and buffalo chicken into 6 containers. Refrigerate for 2-3 days or freeze and enjoy later.

Recipe Name Creamy Garlic Parmesan Chicken Breast Ingredients 1. 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts 2. 2 tbsp olive oil 3. 2 tbsp butter 4. 4 garlic cloves, minced 5. 1 tsp Italian seasoning 6. 1 tsp paprika 7. 1 tsp salt 8. 1/2 tsp black pepper 9. 1 cup heavy cream 10. 1/2 cup chicken broth 11. 3/4 cup grated Parmesan cheese 12. 1 tsp garlic powder 13. 1 tbsp chopped fresh parsley Recipe 1. Season the chicken with salt, pepper, paprika, garlic powder, and Italian seasoning. 2. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. 3. Sear the chicken for 5–6 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. 4. Remove the chicken and keep warm. 5. Melt the butter in the same pan. 6. Add the minced garlic and cook until fragrant. 7. Pour in the chicken broth and heavy cream, stirring well. 8. Add Parmesan cheese and cook until the sauce becomes smooth and creamy. 9. Return the chicken to the skillet and spoon the sauce over the top. 10. Simmer for 3–5 minutes so the flavors combine. 11. Garnish with fresh parsley. 12. Serve with mashed potatoes, pasta, or roasted vegetables. Follow for more delicious recipes!

videos.caption: Creamy Cajun Chicken Pasta 🔥 One-pot & ready in under 20 minutes… juicy cajun chicken served with the creamiest garlic parmesan sauce 🤤 If there is one piece of cookware you need in your kitchen, it’s gotta be the @Made In Cookware Saucier!  I’ve been using Made In for a long time and the Saucier is my favorite piece to cook with… it can do everything your sauce pan can do, but better!  If you’re looking to upgrade your cookware, I linked my favorite Made In pieces in my bio. For the Chicken:  -2 large chicken breasts, flattened  -Seasoning: 1 tbsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp Italian seasoning, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper, 1–2 tsp cayenne pepper (optional)  -1 tbsp olive oil For the Pasta & Sauce:  -8 oz (225 g) rigatoni  -3 tbsp butter  -1 large shallot, finely diced  -6–8 garlic cloves, minced  -1 cup heavy cream, room temperature  -Seasoning: 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp Italian seasoning, 1 tsp black pepper  -3/4 cup freshly grated Parmesan (please use fresh!)  -1/2 cup pasta water, as needed (aka liquid gold) Instructions: 1. Pat the chicken dry & pound to an even thickness. Coat with 1 tbsp olive oil, then season on both sides. 2. Boil the pasta in salted water until just shy of al dente. Save at least 1/2 cup pasta water before draining (‼️). Set pasta aside. 3. Heat a large pan or pot over medium heat for a few mins. Add 2 tbsp olive oil, increase to medium-high, add the chicken. Sear for 3–4 mins per side until golden, then reduce heat if needed and cook through. Set aside to rest. 4. Reduce heat to medium. In the same pan, melt the butter, scraping up all that fond. Add the shallot & cook for 5 mins, add the garlic, cook for 1 more min. 5. Reduce heat to medium-low, slowly pour in the cream. Add the seasonings & simmer for 2–3 mins. Reduce heat to low, add the parmesan & stir until smooth. 6. Add the pasta & 1/4 cup pasta water, toss over low heat for 1–2 mins until the sauce is silky. Add more pasta water as needed. Slice the chicken, add it on top, and finish with more parm and fresh parsley!  #easydinner #pasta #recipe #cookingathometiktoktv

New York Times Top 50 Recipes of 2025 | Smashed Beef Kabob with Cucumber Yogurt @nytcooking @zaynab_issa - 2 cups Greek yogurt - 2 mini cucumbers - 3 tbsp mint - 1 large garlic clove - 1 pound ground beef (80/20) - 1 small yellow onion - ½ tsp ground turmeric - 2 tsp salt - black pepper - ¼ cup walnut halves - 2 tbsp cranberries - Pomegranate molasses, optional, for serving - Warmed pita or white rice, for serving Combine the yogurt, cucumbers, chopped mint, and garlic in a medium bowl, mix well, and chill until ready to serve. In a separate bowl, thoroughly mix the beef, onion, turmeric, 1 teaspoon of salt, and plenty of black pepper. Heat a large, well-seasoned cast-iron skillet over medium-high until very hot, then drop the beef into the pan in large, irregular chunks, cooking undisturbed for 6 to 8 minutes until charred and crisp on the bottom. Toss the meat with a wooden spoon to break up any extra-large pieces, then stir in the walnuts and raisins, cooking for another 2 to 3 minutes until the meat is done and the walnuts are toasted. Finally, season the chilled yogurt with the remaining 1 teaspoon of salt, spread it across the bottom of a serving platter, layer the crispy meat on top, and finish with a drizzle of optional pomegranate molasses, fresh mint leaves, and a side of warmed pita or rice. #kabob #FoodTok #nyt #cooking #beef

This first one is incredibly indulgent and packed with flavour🤤🤌🏽🔥 Macros Per Servings (8 Total) 536 Calories | 52g Protein | 44g Carbs | 17g Fat Ingredients (Makes 8 Servings) Chicken & Seasonings - 800g Raw Chicken Breast, cubed - 800g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs, cubed - 3 Tsp Salt - 5 Tsp Italian Herbs Seasoning - 4 Tsp Garlic Powder - 4 Tsp Onion Powder - 4-5 Tsp Paprika - 6 Tsp Olive Oil Crispy Roasted Potatoes - 1600g Raw Potatoes, cubed - 3 Tsp Italian Herbs Seasoning - 3 Tsp Garlic Powder - 2 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 3 Tsp Paprika - Cooking Spray or 3 Tsp Olive Oil Creamy Sauce + Garnish - 400-450ml Regular or Evaporated Milk - 250g Light Garlic & Herb Cream Cheese - 120g Shredded Mozzarella or any Cheese - Fresh Parsley, finely chopped - Grated Parmesan (optional) 👨‍🍳 Instructions • Slice chicken breast and thighs into cubes. Season well with spices listed and cooking spray then bake in a 200C/400F preheated oven dor 20-22 mins. Creamy garlic parmesan chicken meatballs ✨ Ingredients  Meatballs  - 1.5lbs - 2lbs ground chicken - 1 large egg  - 1/3 cup panko bread crumbs  - 1/4 cup parmesan cheese - 2 tbsp freshly chopped parsley  - 1 tbsp heavy cream - 2 tsp garlic paste - 2 tsp smoked paprika  - 2 tsp garlic powder  - 2 tsp onion powder - 2 tsp complete seasoning  - 2 tsp oregano  - 1 tsp Fire & Smoke Society garlic & herb seasoning  - Salt and pepper to taste Garlic parmesan sauce - 1 1/2 cup heavy cream - 2 cups baby spinach - 1/4 cup unsalted butter (4 tbsp) - 6 garlic cloves (minced) - 1 shallot (minced) - 1 1/4 cups Parmesan cheese (grated)  - 1 tbsp freshly chopped parsley  - 1 1/2 tsp oregano  - 1 1/2 tsp garlic powder - 1 tsp red chili flakes - Salt and pepper to taste Instruction  - Add the ground chicken to a large bowl with the egg, panko, Parmesan, parsley, heavy cream, smoked paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, complete seasoning, oregano, garlic & herb seasoning, salt, and pepper. - Mix until just combined, then form into evenly sized meatballs. - Place the meatballs on a parchment-lined tray and freeze for 30–45 minutes. This helps them firm up and hold their shape while cooking. - Heat a little oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Sear the meatballs on all sides until golden brown and cooked through. Remove and set aside. - In the same skillet, melt the butter. Add the minced shallot and sauté for 1–2 minutes, then add the garlic and cook until fragrant. - Pour in the heavy cream and season with oregano, garlic powder, red chili flakes, salt, and pepper. Stir and bring to a gentle simmer. - Add the Parmesan and stir until melted and the sauce is creamy and smooth. - Add the spinach and cook until wilted. - Return the chicken meatballs to the skillet and coat them in the creamy garlic Parmesan sauce. - Let everything simmer together for a few minutes, then finish with fresh parsley and extra Parmesan. Serve with mashed potatoes or pasta!  • • • #recipe #dinnerideas #chickenrecipe #dinnerrecipes #recipeideas

This was a freaking 1000/10 🤤✨ Apple Pie Pull Apart Bread 🍎🥧🍂 Ingredients: Apple Filling: * 3 apples, peeled and diced * 2 tbsp butter * ⅓ cup brown sugar * 1 tsp cinnamon * ¼ tsp nutmeg * 1 tsp vanilla * 1 tbsp lemon juice * 1 tbsp cornstarch * 2 tbsp water * Pinch of salt Bread * 2 cans refrigerated biscuits * 1 stick butter, melted * 1 cup white sugar * 1 tbsp cinnamon Instructions: 1. Make the apple filling: Cook diced apples with butter, brown sugar, cinnamon, nutmeg, lemon juice, and salt for 6–8 minutes. Mix cornstarch with water and stir it in. Cook 1–2 more minutes until thick. Stir in vanilla and let cool. 2. Make the cinnamon sugar: Mix the white sugar and cinnamon together. 3. Prepare the biscuits: Open each biscuit in half, creating two thinner pieces. 4. Build the layers: Dip each biscuit half in melted butter, then coat it in the cinnamon sugar. Place the pieces into a greased loaf pan, layering them with the apple filling between sections. 5. Bake: Bake at 350°F for 1 hour, or until the center is fully baked.       (The glaze on top is just 1 cup powdered sugar with 2-3 tbsp milk)    #easyrecipe #dessertrecipes #baking #fallrecipes #fallbaking

A recipe from @Sarah Sweets  Ingredients: Instant Banana pudding mix (family size 5.1oz) 2 cups cold milk Mixture: 3 eggs 1/4 cup milk 1 tsp vanilla extract  1/4 cup sugar 12 pack kings hawaiian rolls 3 tbsp salted butter  6 crushed vanilla wafers  Crème brule sugar: 1 cup water  1 cup sugar  How to: In a bowl whisk banana pudding mix with milk. Place in the fridge to thicken up. In a bowl combine eggs, milk, vanilla extract and sugar. Mix well with a fork. Place butter in a pan and turn onto medium heat. Once butter is melted separate rolls and dip into the egg mixture coating all sides. Place in the pan and cook on all sides until golden brown until all are cooked. Next add pudding mix into a piping bag. On the sides of the rolls use a straw to hollow each one out so that you can fit the piping bag into it. Stuff each roll with banana puffing mixture.  In a sauce pan add water and sugar. Place on high heat (no need to stir) until it’s a light golden brown color. Take off the heat. Carefully dip the top of each roll into the sugar and place on parchment paper. Top with a few crushed vanilla wafers immediately. Serve!  #frenchtoast #desserts #banana #howto #breakfast

Arsenio’s Chicken Alfredo Mac N Cheese 👑🧀🍗 Chicken: 1 tsp onion powder 2 tbsp Cajun seasoning 1 tbsp black pepper 2 tsp salt Cube your chicken, season it, then cook it halfway on the stove before finishing it in the oven. Roux: ½ cup butter (113g) ½ cup flour (60g) 3 garlic cloves 1 chicken bouillon cube, grated Salt to taste 1 tsp black pepper 1 tsp smoked paprika Melt the butter, add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Whisk in the flour and cook for 60–90 seconds. Add the grated chicken bouillon cube, then slowly add your milk and cream while whisking until it thickens. Sauce: 3 cups whole milk (720g) 1 cup heavy cream (240g) 3–4 cups shredded cheese (340–450g) — fontina, mozzarella, cheddar Take it off the heat and add your cheese 1 cup at a time until smooth. Pasta: 2 packs Barilla pasta (340g each) Boil the pasta just under al dente, drain and mix it into your cheese sauce. Add the chicken and mix everything together. Put it into a baking dish and cover the top with extra cheese… measure that with your eyes 😂 Bake at 375°F for 15 minutes, then broil on high for 3 minutes. Plate it up and finish with freshly grated Parmesan. 🧀

✨Crispy Garlic Parmesan Chicken Wrap 🌯 Ingredients Chicken * 500g chicken thigh or breast Marinade * 1 tsp cayenne powder * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tsp onion powder * Salt to taste * 1 tsp oregano * 1 tsp dried parsley * ½ tsp black pepper *1/2 tsp red chilli flakes * 1 tbsp ginger & garlic paste *1tbsp oil Garlic Parmesan Sauce * 1 tbsp butter * 2–3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 small white onion, finely chopped * 270ml double cream * ½ cup whole milk * 1 tsp cayenne powder * Salt to taste * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tsp onion powder * 1 tsp oregano * 1 tsp dried parsley * ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan Parmesan Fries * Fries * Parmesan cheese * Cayenne powder * Garlic powder * Salt to taste For the Wrap * Tortilla wraps * Mozzarella cheese * Parmesan cheese * Oil, for frying Method Chicken * Marinate the chicken with all the marinade ingredients for at least 30 minutes. * Heat 2 tbsp butter and 2 tbsp oil in a pan. * Cook the chicken over medium heat for 4–5 minutes per side, or until fully cooked. Slice into strips. Garlic Parmesan Sauce * Melt the butter with a little oil. Sauté the garlic until lightly golden. * Add the onion and cook until softened and lightly golden. * Add the cream and milk, then stir in all the seasonings. * Cook for 2–3 minutes over medium heat. * Add the Parmesan and mix until smooth and creamy. Parmesan Fries * Toss the fries with Parmesan, cayenne, garlic powder and a little salt. Assemble * Spread about 2 tbsp of garlic Parmesan sauce over a tortilla. * Add Parmesan fries and sliced chicken. * Top with mozzarella and Parmesan. * Fold tightly into a wrap. Crisp the Wrap * Heat 1–2 tbsp oil in a pan over medium-low heat. * Cook the wrap for about 2 minutes on each side, until golden and crispy. * Serve with Parmesan sauce and fries. Here are three easy rotisserie chicken meals that are in my dinner rotation.  Just pick up a rotisserie chicken, or two, or three and make a meal prep out of it. I tried a new red enchilada sauce and it was seriously delicious. I was skeptical about the peanut butter, but then I was pleasantly surprised with how delicious it tasted. My entire family loved it!  Here are the recipes and instructions.  *Chicken Alfredo  3 tablespoons salted butter 3 garlic cloves, minced 1 teaspoon onion powder 4 cups heavy cream 1 cup shredded Parmesan cheese 1/2 teaspoon fine sea salt, plus more to taste 1/2 teaspoon ground black pepper, plus more to taste 1 tbsp parsley leaves 16 oz penne pasta  3-4 cups shredded chicken  1 broccoli head, cut into bite sized pieces    1. Cook pasta according to the package instructions until al dente, stirring occasionally.  2. While the pasta cooks, in a small saucepan over medium heat, melt the butter. Add the garlic and onion powder and whisk for 30 seconds, just until fragrant. Whisk in the cream and bring the mixture to a simmer. Reduce the heat to low and add the Parmesan. Whisk until the cheese is melted into the sauce, 1 to 2 minutes. Be careful not to let the sauce boil. Turn off the heat then season with salt and pepper. Add more if needed.  3. Add chicken, broccoli and pasta and toss until everything is coated.  Optional: add red pepper flakes for a little kick  *Chicken Noodle Soup  3 cups shredded chicken  3 Tbsp avocado oil  2 medium carrots,  sliced into thin circles 4 large sticks of celery, finely diced 1 small/medium onion, finely diced 8 cups chicken stock  4 cups water 4 medium potatoes,  peeled and cubed  2 bay leaves 2 Tbsp parsley 1 1/2 tsp fine sea salt, plus more to taste 1/2 tsp black pepper 1 1/2 cups egg noodle pasta, or use 3/4 cup small pasta  1 garlic glove, minced  Directions: 1. In a large soup pot over medium- high heat, add 2 Tbsp olive oil. Once oil is hot, add onions, carrots, and celery and sauté until softened and golden, stirring frequently for 5-7 minutes.  2. Add broth, water, potatoes, bay leaf, 1 1/2 tsp salt and 1/2 tsp black pepper. Bring to a boil and continue cooking at a medium boil for 10 minutes 3. Add pasta and chicken and cook for 5 minutes or until pasta and potatoes are tender. Add more salt and pepper to taste. 4. Press in 1 garlic clove and stir in parsley then remove from heat and enjoy.  *Green Sauce Enchiladas  15-20 corn tortillas (you can make as many or little as you want)  28 ounce can of Las Palmas Green Chile Enchilada Sauce  Avocado oil (enough to cover the bottom of a pan)  1/4 of an onion, diced  2 tsp dried oregano  1 to 2 cups shredded chicken  3/4 tbsps white vinegar  Directions: 1. Add oil to a pan and heat on medium/low heat.  2. Take a stack of 5-10 tortillas, wrap in a paper towel and microwave for a minute. Just enough to soften so they don't break when handled.  3. Once oil is hot, add the tortillas one by one and allow them to lightly fry (2 to 3 seconds) then remove from oil and place them on paper towels to drain.  4. Heat sauce in a medium sized sauce pan on low and bring to a simmer. Remove and set aside. 5. Chop 1/4 cup onion and add about 3/4 tbsp of white vinegar and dried oregano. Mix to combine and set aside.  Assemble: To eat right away- -dip oiled tortillas into sauce. Add shredded chicken and about 1 tsp of the onion, oregano, vinegar mixture then roll up tightly and place in pan with the seam side down. Repeat process with the remaining tortillas.  When you plate them, top with shredded lettuce, queso fresco, and a few slices of avocado. You can also add sour cream and hot sauce. 😉 To freeze them and serve later- *prepare everything the same way but DO NOT add the sauce. Heat and add the sauce when you are ready to eat them.  *Red Sauce Enchiladas  Recipe in comments. In a large bowl, combine the Betty Crocker Yellow Cake Mix, 4 eggs, melted butter, milk, and vanilla extract. 2. Mix until smooth and well combined. 3. Pour the batter into a greased 9x11 baking pan. 4. Bake at 315°F for 37 minutes. 5. Let the cake cool completely. 6. Microwave the Betty Crocker Hershey’s Chocolate Frosting for 15–20 seconds until pourable (warm, not hot). 7. Pour the frosting over the cake, making sure to cover all the corners evenly. 8. Let the frosting set for 1–2 hours. 9. Slice, serve, and enjoy!

Buffalo Chicken Crispy Tacos 🔥 Crispy, saucy buffalo chicken tacos with a creamy garlic lime aioli that you’ll want to dunk everything in 🌮 Lately I’ve been using @Primal Kitchen Foods pure avocado oil to get that golden, high-heat sear. It’s neutral in flavor and perfect for cooking without burning. Now available at Walmart. #PrimalKitchenPartner #primalkitchen Ingredients For the Chicken: -1.5 lb boneless, skinless chicken thighs, very finely diced -Seasonings: 1 tbsp garlic powder, 1 tbsp onion powder, 1 tbsp paprika, 1 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper -3 tbsp avocado oil (divided) from Primal Kitchen -2 tbsp honey -2/3 cup Primal Kitchen’s buffalo sauce -1/4 cup fresh cilantro or parsley, finely chopped Addictive Garlic Lime Sauce: -1/2 cup sour cream -1/2 cup mayonnaise -1 small jalapeño, deseeded (optional) -1 1/2 cups cilantro, leaves and stems -4 to 5 garlic cloves -2 tsp black pepper -1 tsp salt -Juice of 1 lime For Assembly: -10 to 12 mini tortillas -2 cups shredded mozzarella -Avocado oil, for frying  Instructions: 1. Add the diced chicken to a large bowl with all the seasonings and 1 tbsp avocado oil. Mix until every piece is coated. 2. Heat the remaining 2 tbsp avocado oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and cook, stirring occasionally, until  golden and crispy, about 8 minutes. Remove from heat and add-in buffalo sauce, honey, and cilantro. Mix together. 3. Add all sauce ingredients to a blender or food processor. Blend until smooth, bright green, and very hard not to taste repeatedly. 4. Lay a tortilla flat. Sprinkle a thin layer of mozzarella, add 2 to 3 tbsp buffalo chicken, then another light sprinkle of cheese. Fold in half. Repeat until all tacos are built. 5. Heat a thin layer of avocado oil in a pan over medium-low heat. Cook tacos in batches until golden and crispy on both sides, adding more oil as needed. 6. Serve hot, generously drizzle with garlic lime aioli, add extra cilantro if you like, and enjoy the crunch. Dunk responsibly.

videos.caption: Pumpkin Spice Arroz con Leche 🎃🍚 Creamy, cozy arroz con leche with real pumpkin, cinnamon, and warm pumpkin spice. Basically fall in a bowl. 🤎 INGREDIENTS 6 cups water ¼ tsp salt 2 cinnamon sticks 2 cups uncooked long-grain white rice, rinsed and drained 4 cups whole milk 1 (12 oz) can evaporated milk 1 (14 oz) can sweetened condensed milk 1 cup pumpkin purée 2 tsp pumpkin pie spice 1 tsp vanilla extract ½ tsp ground cinnamon Pinch of salt FOR SERVING Ground cinnamon or pumpkin pie spice Whipped cream, optional Chopped toasted pecans, optional INSTRUCTIONS Add the water, ¼ tsp salt, and cinnamon sticks to a large pot and bring to a boil. Stir in the rice and cook for about 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until tender and most of the water has been absorbed. Meanwhile, cook the pumpkin purée in a small pan over medium heat for 2–3 minutes. Stir in the pumpkin pie spice and cinnamon and cook for another 30 seconds until fragrant. Reduce the rice to medium-low and stir in the whole milk, evaporated milk, sweetened condensed milk, pumpkin mixture, vanilla, and a pinch of salt. Cook for another 20–25 minutes, stirring frequently, until creamy and the rice is very tender. Remove the cinnamon sticks and take off the heat while it's still slightly loose, it will thicken as it cools. #arrozconleche #dessert #fallrecipes

Meals for Weight-loss: Ep 8 Honey Garlic Chicken 640 cals, 58g protein, 54 carbs, 12 fat per serving Makes 4 servings You can find all my recipes link in bio!  You would think this is unhealthy but its perfect for meal prep and its SO GOOD! Here is how I made it: 1. Add 1.5 cups jasmine rice and 2.25 cups water to a rice cooker and cook according to the rice cooker settings. 2. In a large bowl, combine 800 g chicken breast, 3 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp honey, 6 cloves minced garlic, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tsp sesame oil, 1 tbsp cornstarch, and 1 tsp black pepper. Mix until the chicken is evenly coated and let it marinate for 20-30 minutes. 3. Air fry the chicken at 400°F for 10-12 minutes, shaking the basket halfway through, until cooked through and lightly caramelized. 4. Heat 1 tbsp avocado oil in a wok over medium-high heat. Add 4 cloves minced garlic and cook for about 30 seconds until fragrant. Add 600 g broccoli florets and stir-fry for 4-5 minutes. Pour in 2-3 tbsp water, cover for 1 minute, then uncover and season with 1 tbsp soy sauce, ½ tsp black pepper, and a pinch of salt. Toss everything together for another 1-2 minutes, then set aside. 5. In the same wok, add 4 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp honey, 6 cloves minced garlic, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, and ¾ cup water. Bring to a simmer. Mix 2 tsp cornstarch with 2 tbsp water and stir it into the sauce. Cook for 1-2 minutes until the sauce thickens. Add the cooked chicken and toss until every piece is coated. 6. Divide the rice, broccoli, and honey garlic chicken between 4 meal prep containers. Finish with sliced green onions and sesame seeds. Now it’s time to enjoy! #healthyrecipes #mealprep #healthyfoodshare #amateurprochef #takeoutrecipes

Crispy garlic parmesan chicken rolls Ingredients  For the chicken: 2 lb boneless chicken breast, cut into small pieces  Salt to taste 1 tsp black pepper  1 tbsp garlic powder  1 tsp onion powder  2 tsp paprika powder  1/2 tsp cumin powder  1 tbsp lemon juice  1 tbsp oil (for marinating) 1 small yellow onion, diced 1 red bell pepper, diced 2 tbsp oil for cooking  For the garlic parmesan sauce: 1 tbsp butter  1 tbsp garlic, minced  1 1/2 cup unsweetened heavy whipping cream 1 tbsp cream cheese  Salt to taste 1/2 tsp black pepper  1 tsp garlic powder  1 tsp red chili flakes  1 cup Parmesan cheese , freshly grated  1 tsp parsley , finely chopped  To assemble: 9-10 small flour tortilla wraps 1 cup mozzarella cheese  Oil for pan frying  Method: Season chicken with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, cumin, lemon juice, and oil. Mix well. Heat 2 tbsp oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook chicken until fully cooked and lightly golden. Add diced onion and bell pepper and sauté for 2–3 minutes until softened. Set aside. For the sauce, melt butter over medium-low heat. Add garlic and sauté for 30 seconds. Add heavy cream, cream cheese, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and red chili flakes. Whisk until smooth and simmer until slightly thickened. Lower the heat and stir in Parmesan until melted and smooth. Turn off the heat and add parsley. Reserve half the sauce for dipping and mix the remaining half with the chicken. Let cool slightly. Add a few spoonfuls of filling to each tortilla and sprinkle with mozzarella. Fold in the sides and roll tightly. Lightly oil a skillet over medium to medium-low heat. Place rolls seam-side down and cook, turning until golden and crispy on all sides. Add more oil as needed. Avoid high heat so the tortilla doesn't brown before the cheese melts. Sprinkle with fresh parsley and Parmesan and serve immediately with the reserved garlic Parmesan dipping sauce. #recipe #garlicparmesan #chickenrolls

dinner with a dietitian: street corn inspired chicken rice bowls..you don’t even have to turn on the oven. 👌🏻 Flavor + Nutrition are my top 2 priorities when it comes to dinner. What I love about these: Balanced meal with lots of nutrition. Great for meal prep. Easy to customize. Full recipe below ⬇️ or grab it here: https://mallorythedietitian.com/street-corn-chicken-rice-bowl/ INGREDIENTS For Chicken • 1½ lb chicken breasts (or thighs) • 3 Tbsp extra virgin olive oil (1 for marinating + 2 for cooking) • 1½ tsp chili powder • 1 tsp each: smoked paprika, garlic powder • ½ tsp onion powder • ½ tsp kosher salt • ¼ tsp black pepper For Dressing • 1 c Greek yogurt • 2 Tbsp mayo • 1 lime, zest & juice • ½ tsp each: chili powder, smoked paprika, garlic powder • ½ tsp kosher salt • ¼ tsp black pepper • 1-3 Tbsp water (as needed to thin it out) For Street Corn • 3 c corn, cooked • ½ red bell pepper, chopped • 1 small jalapeno, chopped • ¼ c red onion, chopped • ¼ c cilantro, chopped • ¼ c cotija cheese For Cilantro Lime Rice • 1 c jasmine rice, uncooked • 1 Tbsp extra virgin olive oil • ½ c cilantro, chopped • 2 Tbsp lime juice • ½ tsp each: garlic powder, kosher salt • ¼ tsp black pepper For Assembling (opt) • romaine  • avo • tomatoes DIRECTIONS 1. Prep chicken: Cut chicken into cubes. Coat in 1 Tbsp olive oil + seasonings. Set aside to let marinade. 2. Make rice: cook rice according to package. Mix in cilantro, lime, olive oil, gp, s&p. 3. Prep Dressing: make the Elote dressing by mixing the ingredients listed. 4. Make Street Corn: remove corn from cob & chop the jalapeno, red pepper, onion, & cilantro. Add everything to a  bowl. Top w/cotija cheese & half the dressing. 5. Cook chicken: heat a skillet on medium-high. Add olive oil until hot. Add chicken & cook 3-4 min on one side. Flip & cook another 3-4 min until cooked to internal temp 165℉ (75°C) 6. Assemble: Add romaine (opt), rice, chicken & corn to a bowl. Top with more dressing, lime, & fave toppings!  NUTRITION (per bowl, makes 6)* 470 cal, 34g pro, 43g carb, 19g fat *nutrition info based on serving size rec: ½ c chicken, ½ c rice, ¾ c corn salad, 2 Tbsp dressing, ½ c romaine (opt) Follow for healthy recipes! Chicken au poivre.  I can’t get over how good this was. 100/100. This has definitely been added to my weekly rotation 🤤 Ingredients Chicken 4-5 chicken thighs 1 tsp black pepper  ¾ tsp salt ½ tsp garlic powder ½ tsp onion powder 1/2 tsp smoked paprika (optional) 1/2 tsp dried thyme (optional) 1 tbsp olive oil Creamy Pepper Sauce 1/2 white onion, very finely chopped 3 garlic cloves minced  2 tbsp crushed peppercorns  1/4 tsp rosemary  150 ml chicken stock 100 ml double cream 1 tsp Dijon mustard 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce  1 tbsp butter Salt, to taste Extra crushed black pepper, if needed Parsley chopped  Crispy Baby Potatoes baby potatoes 1–1½ tbsp olive oil Salt Black pepper 1/4 tsp dried thyme  1/4 tsp rosemary 1 tbsp butter 1/2 tsp garlic Method  Potatoes Groove the baby potatoes with a wedge cutter. Boil in salted water for 6–8 minutes, then drain and steam-dry. Toss with oil, salt, pepper and herbs. Air fry at 190°C for 15 minutes, shake, then 200°C for 5–8 minutes. Add butter and crushed garlic for the last 2–3 minutes. Chicken Pat the thighs dry and apply the prepared seasoning. Sear in 1 tbsp oil over medium-high heat for 5–7 minutes per side, until cooked through. Remove and rest. Pepper Sauce In the same pan, add 1 tbsp butter and finely chopped white onion and garlic. Cook for 2–3 minutes. Add in the crushed peppercorns, add the chicken stock, scrape the pan and simmer for 2–3 minutes. Add the mustard, Worcestershire sauce and rosemary. Stir in the double cream, simmer for 3–5 minutes until slightly thickened. Return the chicken to the sauce for 1–2 minutes. Sprinkle chopped parsley if using.  (Adjust all seasonings to your preference) #dinnerideas #chickendinnerideas #EasyRecipes #easydinner #homecooking

Creamy Chipotle Chicken & Potatoes🍗🍟🧀 One of the most indulgent meal prep recipes, so creamy, rich in flavour and packed with protein. Using a sheet pan is a game changer for batch cooking🔥 Macros Per Serving (6 Total) 548 Calories | 51g Protein | 52g Carbs | 17g Fat Ingredients (Makes 6 Servings) Chipotle Chicken Marinade - 1200g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs, trim excess fat - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 3 Tsp Parsley - 3 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 2.5 Tsp Cumin - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 100g Chipotle Paste - 1 and 1/2 Limes, juiced - 30g or 6 Tsp Olive Oil Let this marinate overnight if possible, way more flavor! Crispy Seasoned Potatoes - 1300g Raw Yellow Potatoes, cubed - 2.5 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Italian Herbs - 3 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 2.5 Tsp Onion Powder - Avocado Cooking Spray, heavy pass Creamy Chipotle Sauce - 20g Light Butter - 150-200g Red Onion, finely chopped - 1.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 60-80g Chipotle Paste (depends how spicy you want it) - 400g Light Evaporated Milk - 110g Light Cream Cheese - Freshly Chopped Parsley, garnish 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from chicken thighs. Add seasonings, chipotle paste, lime juice, and olive oil. Mix well and marinate. 2. Heat a large pan on low, add butter and chopped red onion. Cook for 5-7 mins until softened and lightly browned. Add seasonings and chipotle paste, mix, and cook for another 5 mins until caramelised. 3. Keep the heat low, add evaporated milk and cream cheese. Stir continuously until smooth, rich, and creamy. 4. Cube up potatoes, add seasoning and cooking spray, then mix well. Spread on a lined sheet pan and roast at 200C / 390F for 25 mins until golden and crispy. Season with salt, then fold into the sauce with fresh parsley until fully coated. 5. Spread marinated chicken on sheet pan, oven bake 25 mins 200C / 390F until golden and juicy. Cut into cubes, serve with creamy potatoes and ENJOY! . . . . #chipotle #chickenrecipes #mealprep #highprotein #healthyrecipes

This One Pot Marry Me Chicken Gnocchi is creamy, cheesy, packed with flavor, and SO easy 😍 Everything cooks in one pan, including the gnocchi, so you get the creamiest sauce with barely any cleanup. Save this one for your next easy weeknight dinner! One Pot Marry Me Chicken Gnocchi Recipe  Ingredients: 2 boneless, skinless chicken breasts, diced 2 tbsp olive oil 1 tbsp minced garlic Italian seasoning Paprika Salt Pepper Onion powder Garlic powder 1 cup chicken broth 1 cup heavy cream ½ cup sun dried tomatoes, chopped 1 lb potato gnocchi ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan 2 cups fresh spinach Crushed red pepper flakes Directions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add diced chicken and season with Italian seasoning, paprika, salt, pepper, onion powder and garlic powder. Cook until browned and cooked through. Add minced garlic and cook for about 30 seconds. Add chicken broth, heavy cream, sun dried tomatoes and crushed red pepper flakes. Season the sauce with Italian seasoning, salt, pepper, onion powder and garlic powder. Stir to combine. Add the uncooked gnocchi directly to the pan. Bring to a gentle simmer and cook for 5–7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the gnocchi is tender and the sauce has thickened. Stir in freshly grated Parmesan until melted and creamy. Add spinach and stir until wilted. #marrymechicken #onepotmeal #easydinner #dinnerrecipe #weeknightdinner

GROUND BEEF BULGOGI A quick, savory Korean‑inspired beef bowl that’s perfect for weeknights. INGREDIENTS Main 1 lb ground beef 1 onion, sliced 1 tbsp minced garlic Oil, for cooking Sesame oil, for finishing Sesame seeds, garnish Chopped scallion, garnish Kimchi or radish kimchi, for serving Sauce 2 tbsp brown sugar 2 tbsp mirin 4 tbsp soy sauce (low sodium preferred) 1 tbsp Korean plum syrup* *Sub: 1 tbsp water + 1 tsp apple cider vinegar INSTRUCTIONS 1. Peel and slice the onion; set aside. 2. Combine brown sugar, mirin, soy sauce, and plum syrup (or substitute). Mix well and set aside. 3. Heat a little oil in a pan. Add sliced onions and cook for 1 minute. Add minced garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant. 4. Add ground beef and break it into small pieces. Once the beef is about 30% cooked, pour in the sauce. Let it simmer until the sauce reduces and evaporates — stir occasionally. (This part takes a little time, but it’s worth it.) 5. Drizzle with sesame oil and give it a final mix. 6. Assemble your bowl with rice, scallions, sesame seeds, and kimchi/ veggie of choice. Enjoy!

9 Best Things to Do in Marrakesh 🕌✨ 1) Stay in a Riad 🛏️  feel the authentic Moroccan vibe, from the mosaic tiles to the whisper-quiet courtyards. Riads offer privacy, fewer crowds, and a home-away-from-home feel with traditional decor, often a peaceful rooftop terrace, and staff who treat you like family. Perfect for a truly Moroccan experience without the hotel hustle. 2) Best Coffee at Bacha Coffee ☕️✨ (Location: https://goo.gl/maps/6u3Xx9J9xqv1w9Qw7) Silky espresso, perfectly balanced blends, and a chic, relaxed atmosphere. Great latte art, friendly baristas, and a bright, stylish space to post your vibes. Pro tip: try their signature crush coffee and pastry pairing. 3) Explore the Souks 🧿🌀 Fun tip: haggle with a smile, never agree to the first price! Make it a playful game, sample spices, and test your bargaining skills. Lose yourself in ribbons of color, leather, pottery, and lamps. The thrill of the find is half the fun! 4) Visit Ben Youssef Madrasa 🕌 A jaw-dropping historic site with intricate tilework, carved wood, and serene courtyards. It’s a perfect spot for photos that scream old-world Marrakech charm. 5) Jardin Majorelle 🌿💙 iconic cobalt-blue paths, lush botanical displays, and a peaceful escape from the market buzz. A must-see for color lovers and plant enthusiasts, plus it’s connected to the Yves Saint Laurent legacy. 6) Ourika Valley Day Trip 🚙🌄 about 1 hour from central Marrakech (depending on traffic). What to expect: stunning valley scenery, Berber villages, waterfalls, and a cooler climate. A refreshing break from the medina with photo-worthy viewpoints. 7) Agafay Desert Experience 🐫🏜️ Highlights: camel ride under the open sky, squad  bike moments, and magical desert views. Luxe touch: stay at a desert camp with plush lounges, gourmet meals, and starlit dinners. Perfect for a memorable  outing. 8) Dinner at La Trattoria 🍝🇮🇹  warm, cozy ambiance with authentic Italian flavors in Marrakech. Great for a relaxed evening, fresh pastas, and a lively dining vibe after a day of exploration. 9) Jemaa el-Fnaa - The Heart of Marrakech 🎭💃 Do it for the vibes: bustling square, street performances, snake charmers, and a feast for the senses. Pro tip: bring some cash for photos with performers and for quick bites. Best times: late afternoon into evening when the energy peaks. #Marrakesh #Morocco #TravelTikTok #Riads #Souks

Sticky Chicken Tender, seasoned chicken coated in a sweet and savory sticky sauce, served over warm rice and finished with green onions and sesame seeds. Ingredients For the Chicken 1.5 lbs chicken breast, cut into bite-sized pieces 1 teaspoon each onion powder, garlic powder, and teaspoon salt ½ teaspoon each black pepper and paprika  2 tablespoons olive oil About ⅓ cup cornstarch Olive oil, for cooking For the Sticky Sauce ½ cup soy sauce ⅓ cup brown sugar or honey 1 tablespoon hoisin sauce 1 tablespoon ketchup 1 teaspoon ginger paste ½ tablespoon minced garlic 1 tablespoon cornstarch 2 tablespoons butter For Serving Cooked white rice Sliced green onions Sesame seeds Instructions 1. Add the chicken to a large bowl and season with onion powder, garlic powder, salt, black pepper, and paprika. Add 2 tablespoons of olive oil and toss until the chicken is evenly coated. 2. Sprinkle about ⅓ cup cornstarch over the seasoned chicken and toss until each piece is lightly and evenly coated. This helps give the chicken that tender, velvety texture and creates a great coating for the sauce. 3. In a bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, brown sugar or honey, hoisin sauce, ketchup, ginger paste, minced garlic, and 1½ tablespoons cornstarch until smooth. Set aside. 4. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken in 2 batches so you don't overcrowd the pan. Cook until golden brown on the outside and cooked through. Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside. 5. Reduce the heat and add 2 tablespoons of butter to the same skillet, scraping up all those flavorful browned bits from the bottom of the pan. 6. Pour the prepared sauce into the skillet. Cook over low heat, whisking frequently, until the sauce begins to bubble and thickens into a glossy, sticky consistency. 7. Add the cooked chicken back to the skillet and toss until every piece is completely coated in the sticky sauce. 8. Spoon the sticky chicken over warm rice and finish with sliced green onion.  #easyrecipe #dinnerideas #quickrecipes #easydinner #dinnerrecipes

Sheet Pan Garlic Parmesan Chicken and Potatoes 🧄🧈 For ALL of you asking about the app, search “Osta” on the app or Google play store 🫶 Minimal effort, maximum flavor… juicy chicken, crispy potatoes covered in garlicky parmesan butter perfection 🔥 For the potatoes: - 1.5 lbs (680 g) baby potatoes - 1/3 cup butter, melted - 1 cup parmesan cheese - 8 garlic cloves, minced - Seasonings: 2 tsp each of paprika, oregano, garlic powder, salt, black pepper - 3 tbsp olive oil For the chicken: - 6 to 8 chicken thighs, boneless & skinless - Seasonings: 1 tbsp seasoning salt, 1 tbsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp italian seasoning, 1 tsp cumin - 1 lemon, juiced - 2 tbsp mayonnaise For the garlic & onion: - 2 garlic heads + 2 tbsp olive oil + 2 tsp salt - 1 red onion, cut into chunks + olive oil, drizzled For the Aioli:  - 1/3 cup greek yogurt + 1/3 cup mayonnaise - 2 roasted garlic heads - 1/4 lemon, juiced - 2 tsp black pepper + 1 tsp salt - 3 tbsp chives, chopped For the Baste (optional ): - 1/4 cup mayonnaise  - 1/4 cup parmesan  - 2 tsp paprika Instructions: 1. In a bowl, combine the chicken, seasonings, lemon juice, garlic, and mayonnaise. Mix well and marinate for as long as you wish (up to overnight). 2. Preheat your oven to 375°F (190°C). Add the potatoes to a large casserole dish. Toss with the melted butter, parmesan, olive oil, garlic, and seasonings. Spread evenly. 3. Top with the chicken thighs. Add the red onion chunks around the dish & drizzle them with olive oil.  4. Slice the tops off the garlic heads, drizzle with olive oil and salt, wrap in foil, & place in dish. 5. Bake for 40 mins. Broil for the last 2–3 mins if desired.  6. Optional but recommended: Mix together mayo, parmesan, and paprika. At the 20-min mark, baste the chicken & return to the oven. 7. In a bowl, combine the yogurt, mayo, lemon juice, salt, pepper, and chives. Squeeze in as much of the roasted garlic as you wish OR chop them up first. Mix. 8. Finish with fresh parm, chives, & lemon slices. Enjoy! #recipe #cookingathometiktoktv #dinner #recipesoftiktok #dinnerideas

✨ Creamy Garlic Chicken & Mashed Potatoes 🤍🧄🥔 🕒 Total Time: ~35 minutes 🍽️ Serves: 4-6 📋 Ingredients: • 2 lbs chicken breasts, sliced in half lengthwise • 2 tbsp olive oil • 2 tbsp butter • 2 tbsp all-purpose flour • 1½ cups chicken broth • 1 cup heavy cream or half-and-half • ½ cup grated parmesan cheese • Garlic salt • Onion powder • Paprika • Black pepper • Mashed potatoes, for serving 👩🏼‍🍳 Directions: 1. Season chicken generously with garlic salt, onion powder, paprika, and black pepper. 2. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. 3. Cook chicken 4-5 minutes per side until golden brown and cooked through. Remove from skillet and set aside. 4. Reduce heat to medium. Add butter to the skillet and let melt. 5. Whisk in flour and cook for 1-2 minutes to create a roux. 6. Slowly pour in chicken broth while whisking until smooth and thickened. 7. Stir in heavy cream (or half-and-half) and parmesan cheese. Simmer until the gravy is rich, creamy, and silky smooth. 8. Return the chicken to the skillet and spoon the sauce over top. Simmer for 3-5 minutes. 9. Serve over warm mashed potatoes and drizzle with plenty of that creamy garlic gravy. ✨ This is the kind of dinner that has everyone asking for seconds and a piece of bread to clean the plate. 🤍 #CreamyGarlicChicken #DinnerAtRileys #ComfortFood #EasyDinnerRecipe #FamilyDinner

Creamy lemon chicken makes a quick easy and delicious dinner perfect for those busy nights. 1 tsp salt 1/2 tsp garlic powder 1/4 tsp pepper  1/4 tsp paprika 1/2 tsp Italian seasoning  2 pounds boneless skinless chicken breast 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour  1/2 cup shredded Parm 4 cloves crushed garlic 2 tbs freshly squeezed lemon juice  1 tbs lemon zest 1 tbs olive oil 4 tbs butter 1 cup heavy whipping cream  1 cup water For the sauce: I/2 tsp salt 1/4 tsp salt Season chicken breast with seasoning on both sides then brown in a pan over high heat in olive oil. Remove the chicken from the pan. In the same pan, add butter and one melted, add garlic. Sauté for a minute and then add in flour and sauté an additional minute. Add in water, lemon juice, and heavy cream. Once the sauce comes together, add in lemon zest, Parmesan cheese and salt and pepper. Stir until the cheese is fully melted then add the chicken back to the pan. Cover with the lid and simmer for five minutes. Spoon the sauce over the chicken. Top with chopped parsley and sliced lemon. . . . #lemonchicken #easyrecipes #dinnerideas #chickenrecipe #quickrecipe

Chicken Broccoli Cheddar Dump & Bake 🥦🧀 Easy, creamy, cheesy, and all made in one dish! Perfect for a simple weeknight dinner.  🛒INGREDIENTS: • 2 packs Knorr Broccoli & Cheddar Rice • 2 cans reduced-sodium Cream of Chicken • Chicken broth, using the 2 empty soup cans to measure • 1 lb chicken tenderloins • 1 bag frozen broccoli  • Shredded cheddar cheese 🧂SEASONINGS:  • Chicken seasoning (I used Chicka Licka Bam)  • Garlic powder • Onion powder • Paprika • Dried parsley 👩‍🍳HOW TO MAKE IT: 1. Preheat oven to 375°F. 2. Add both packs of Knorr Broccoli & Cheddar Rice and both cans of reduced-sodium Cream of Chicken to a 9x13 baking dish. 3. Fill each empty Cream of Chicken can with chicken broth, pour the broth into the baking dish, and mix everything well. 4. Steam the frozen broccoli according to the package directions, then dice it into smaller pieces. 5. Evenly distribute the diced broccoli over the rice mixture, gently nesting some of it into the rice. 6. Place the chicken tenderloins on top, season with the seasonings listed above, then drizzle with oil and rub the oil and seasonings evenly over the chicken. 7. Cover tightly with foil and bake for 35 minutes. 8. Remove the foil and sprinkle shredded cheddar cheese over the top. 9. Return to the oven and bake uncovered for about 10 minutes.   10. Let rest for a few minutes, then serve & enjoy!! #DumpAndBake #ChickenDinner #EasyDinner #ChickenRecipes #EasyRecipes
